source.title: Tales of Eternia Remastered
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Language, Suggestive ThemesGamesTales of Eternia RemasteredVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalFantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Language, Suggestive ThemesLoadingFrom opposite skies, voices unite.Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at StakeJourney to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and FreedomFeaturing the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to PlayGameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.Software description provided by the publisher.Related tagsRole playingChoose your difficultyPixel artRaise your statsVoiced charactersShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)7 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Learn moreSystemNintendo Switch 2PublisherBandai Namco EntertainmentSupported languagesJapanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, American EnglishRelease dateOctober 16, 2026ESRB ratingFantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Language, Suggestive ThemesAbout Supported ControllersIn the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version, certain minigames within the main game support mouse controls.WARNING: If you have epilepsy or have had seizures or other unusual reactions to flashing lights or patterns, consult a doctor before playing video games. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.
